resources.string: Read only. Shown on the vitals screen as cards of their own, each beside your usual figure for the four weeks before. A watch or a ring measures these, usually overnight; this app does not compute them and writes nothing back.
Measured by a watch or a ring while you were at rest, usually overnight, and read from Health Connect or an export file. It sits below a pulse taken during the day by design.
Your usual figure is the median of your own readings in the 28 days before the latest one, and needs at least five of them. It compares you with yourself; it is not a verdict.
